title: Teradata Vantage to Google Cloud Platform Migration
opportunity:
The Client is planning to migrate its current Teradata Vantage data warehouse environment, along with its associated workloads, to a modern, future-state cloud data warehouse built on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The migration will follow a lift-and-shift strategy with minimal to no data model changes, aiming to completely retire the legacy 21 TB Teradata system by the end of Phase 1 (Target: October 2024).

Onix proposes to provide professional services utilizing our accelerated agile "Sprint-Wise" methodology and the Onix Bird Automation Suite (Eagle, Raven, Pelican). Onix's subject matter experts will execute the preparation, conversion, implementation, and rigorous validation of the migration to build 100% confidence for the Teradata sunset, ensuring zero data movement discrepancies and mitigating risks through extended parallel runs.

The Client's current landscape and target scope consist of an upstream AWS S3 source system integrating into the Teradata Vantage warehouse. Data transformation pipelines are currently powered by IBM Datastage (940 Sequence Jobs, 3,969 Parallel Jobs) and Alteryx (394 Workflows), with orchestration managed via Cloud Composer. The downstream reporting layer involves SAP BusinessObjects (10 Universes, 2,041 Reports), Tableau (295 Reports), Periscope (5 Reports), and Power BI (5 Reports).
solution_overview:
The proposed solution leverages an Accelerated Agile "Sprint-Wise" approach, avoiding a big-bang migration and ensuring continuous, verifiable delivery. This methodology facilitates the preparation, intelligent conversion, and structured implementation of the migration while executing extended parallel runs for rigorous risk mitigation prior to the final cutover.

Central to this solution is the Onix Bird Automation Suite. Onix Eagle (The Planner) will be used for automated workload discovery, granular assessment, lineage dependency mapping, and migration sprint planning. Onix Raven (The Transformer) will drive intelligent, automated code conversion, translating Teradata objects (BTEQ, DDLs) and ETL mappings directly to GCP-native formats. Finally, Onix Pelican (The Validator) will ensure high-fidelity, cell-level data validation and reconciliation between the legacy Teradata system and GCP BigQuery with absolutely zero data movement.

The architectural approach prioritizes a direct migration of Teradata historical data to GCP BigQuery and establishes an incremental pipeline for continuous synchronization from AWS S3 to Google Cloud Storage (GCS). This targeted Phase 1 solution achieves the early retirement of Teradata by rehosting Datastage on GCP, natively repointing existing ETL jobs and all designated BI reporting tools seamlessly to BigQuery.

2.3 Historical Data Migration: One-time historical data migration of 21 TB from Teradata Vantage to Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery).

2.4 Code Conversion: Utilization of Onix Raven (The Transformer) for intelligent, automated conversion of legacy logic.
Conversion of existing Teradata DDLs to BigQuery native format exactly matching 9,118 Tables and 3,858 Views.

Repointing and re-platforming existing ETL workflows: IBM Datastage (940 Sequence Jobs, 3,969 Parallel Jobs) re-hosted on GCP; Alteryx (394 Workflows) repointed while remaining on AWS.
Converted code strictly preserves existing business logic (Lift and Shift methodology) with identically mapped schemas and data types.

2.5 Source System Integration: Design and build an incremental ingestion pipeline from AWS S3 to Google Cloud Storage (GCS) to ensure continuous data synchronization.
Leverage native GCP tools (Storage Transfer Service, Dataflow, or Pub/Sub) to maintain ongoing deltas from the AWS S3 upstream systems until Teradata decommissioning.
Support flat files, database extracts, and required APIs delivered to the AWS S3 buckets.

2.6 Orchestration and Scheduling: Setup, configure, and migrate legacy job orchestration to Cloud Composer (managed Apache Airflow) for migrated GCP workflows.
Develop, deploy, and test DAGs corresponding to the migrated Datastage, Alteryx, and BigQuery execution chains.
Strictly mirror legacy scheduling sequences, dependencies, and execution times for the newly established DAGs.

Repoint SAP BO (10 Universes, 2,041 Reports), Tableau (295 Reports), Periscope (5 Reports), and Power BI (5 Reports).

Conduct schema refreshes within the BI tools without rewriting report logic, altering UI layouts, or redesigning dashboard semantics.

Technical Limitations: Onix will repoint connections and conduct schema refreshes within the BI tools, but will not rewrite report logic, alter UI layouts, or redesign dashboard semantics.
Stress Testing and Peak Load Testing are entirely out of scope.
100% conversion of targeted code is based strictly on volumetrics defined in this SOW (9,118 Tables, 3,858 Views, 67 SPs, 115 BTEQs); volumes exceeding this will be handled via a Change Request.
Data integrity errors or corruption originating within legacy Teradata/AWS S3 data that impede the migration timeline will require timeline extensions.

Client Dependency Constraints: Client must formally sign off on deliverables within five (5) business days, otherwise deliverables are deemed approved to protect agile sprint timelines.
Onix relies entirely on the Client for 24/7 proactive monitoring and escalation via ticketing during the hypercare warranty support phase.
Client holds full responsibility for procuring, upgrading, or scaling third-party ETL/BI tools if platform-level performance issues emerge inherently post-repointing.
Delays or performance degradation caused by suboptimal network bandwidth are the sole responsibility of the Client.

Primary Outcomes: 100% Guaranteed conversion of targeted in-scope code to cloud-native technologies.
100% validated and matching data reconciled between Teradata and GCP to build definitive confidence to sunset the legacy platform.
Teradata Vantage environment fully migrated and technically capable of being retired by the end of Phase 1 (Target: October 2024).

General Assumptions: The migration strategy is strictly lift-and-shift. Workloads will be migrated with minimal or no data model changes.
Business logic inside processing scripts, pipelines, and reporting feeds will be preserved exactly as-is.
Onix Eagle, Raven, and Pelican products are deployed solely for the duration of this engagement.

The Client will enforce a strict code freeze on Teradata pipelines, tables, and ingestion logic prior to the start of the respective migration sprint. Alterations post-freeze will require a formal Change Request (CR).
The Client will manage their own CI/CD repositories, ITSM mapping tools, and operational monitoring platforms.
The Client is solely responsible for coordinating with third-party vendors (e.g., SAP, IBM, Alteryx) to resolve any native integration platform issues.

Project Specific Assumptions: Phase 1 targets the retirement of Teradata by October 2024. Dependencies impacting this timeline (e.g., UAT delays, network issues) may shift this target.
Alteryx workflows will definitively remain hosted on AWS and will not be migrated to GCP infrastructure, only repointed to query BigQuery.
Datastage environments will be re-hosted onto GCP infrastructure by Onix utilizing the Client's existing licenses.
Infrastructure (VMs/Compute) and security whitelisting required to host Onix Pelican will be provided and financially borne by the Client at no cost to Onix.

The Client will provide VPN/VDI access, unrestricted source access, necessary security approvals, and a functioning dedicated cloud interconnect between GCP and corporate networks 1 week prior to Sprint Start.
